messages:
mira_cs: Quick sync — I pulled the cost forecast sheet for Nimbula and I'm prepping notes for the QBR next Wed. Need a short pack: (1) 90d token burn, (2) onboarding seats still in trial, (3) top 2 embedding routes causing spend. Can folks drop numbers by EOD?

sam_finops: Pasted quick snapshot into thread so you can copy to slides:
```csv
period,tokens
last_30,3.2M
last_90,9.8M
est_next_30,4.1M
avg_daily,110k
```

alejandra_pm: Thanks — I'll take onboarding status. FYI 12 users are stuck on data-connector step (waiting on SSO), 4 in trial but heavy embed usage. I'll run a 20m enablement next Tue and share the invite. Can we also propose a temporary credits buffer for them?

raj_se: Mitigation ideas: enable prefix caching for their common prompts, and route background indexing to a smaller model. Also add a per-account burst cap to avoid runaway charges. Small config snippet I recommend:
```yaml
policy:
  burst_cap: 1.5M_tokens/day
  fallback_model: redwood-small-qr
  prefix_cache: true
```

cost-bot: Alert: Nimbula exceeded daily threshold (1.2M tokens) yesterday at 23:17 UTC. Ticket #CS-4317 created.

mira_cs: Perfect — I'll fold all of this into a 1-slide QBR ask: 15k credits buffer + enablement session + throttle policy. @sam_finops can you confirm projected monthly $ impact if we apply prefix caching (conservative) so we can justify the buffer? :thumbsup:

sam_finops: Quick estimate: prefix caching could reduce token spend ~22% -> projected ~ $1,900/mo for next quarter (conservative). I'll update the sheet and post the final number in #customer-success by EOD.

mira_cs: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll draft the slide and share for review later today.
